sentences.text: Nodal analysis provides a general procedure for analyzing a circuit using node voltages as the circuit variables.
Second, label the non-reference node voltages as v1, v2, up to vn-1.

Third, apply Kirchhoff's Current Law to each non-reference node, expressing branch currents using Ohm's Law: i = (v_high - v_low) / R. Fourth, solve the resulting system of simultaneous linear equations to determine all unknown node voltages.
